action_items: No backend tests were added: both acceptance criteria are pure UI/CSS surface concerns with no API-bearing behavior (pytest suite collected 0 tests, as expected).

checks.criterion: Shared section-number badges remain readable and correctly sized across standard and inverse sections
checks.name: portfolio-section-badge-contrast
checks.evidence: Verified Skills section-number badge (testid skills-section-number, text '02') and LeetCode section-number badge (testid leetcode-section-number, text '05') are both ~28x28px. In light mode Skills badge is black bg/light text (bg[0]<60, fg[0]>180) and LeetCode (inverse) badge is light bg/dark text (bg[0]>180, fg[0]<60); background != foreground color for both. After toggling to dark mode via theme-toggle-button (html[data-theme=dark]), background still != foreground for both badges, confirming contrast is preserved. Light mode restored afterward.

checks.criterion: LeetCode recent-submission status spans match the shared high-contrast badge styling
checks.name: portfolio-leetcode-submission-badge-style
checks.evidence: Intercepted https://leetpulse-api.vercel.app/api/leetcode/solved/paladnan70930 and .../calendar/paladnan70930 with page.route to deterministically return stats (62/28/31/3) and one recent submission ('tscheck Two Sum Mock', statusDisplay 'Accepted', 2m ago). leetcode-submission-status-1 rendered text 'Accepted' as a filled monochrome badge: computed bg and color differ (contrast), both bg and fg are monochrome (R≈G≈B, no green/red dominant channel), confirming it uses the shared --section-text/--section-bg badge treatment instead of a green/red outline. Screenshot shows a solid white 'ACCEPTED' pill on the dark inverse LeetCode section, visually consistent with the '06 CONTACT' section-number badge below it.
